note: Authoritative user-facing surface of the desktop application, taken from NextMain.MENU_DATA - the menu the operator actually sees. 198 named items across 13 tabs. This is the register Phase 2 must drive to zero unclassified.
source: NextMain.MENU_DATA joined to the MDI_FORM.cs dispatch

states.unclassified: not yet assessed - the starting state for every item
states.verified: web equivalent exists AND has been compared or tested; evidence path required
states.implemented-unverified: web equivalent exists but nothing proves it matches
states.implemented-elsewhere: covered by a differently-named web feature; note must say which
states.dead-in-dataset: no real rows in Live24; note must carry the count
states.scope-excluded: deliberately out of scope; note must record the decision

caveat: formReferencedInWeb is a WEAK positive and a STRONG negative. A form named in a comment is not implemented, and a function can exist under another name. It orders the work; it does not classify it.
